meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: External debt of India, quarterly, US$ (DBIE Data Query element EXT_DBT_RT_RN)
meta.coverage: India's external debt at the end of every quarter since June 2004, in dollars, by creditor and instrument
meta.note: RBI DBIE Data Query element EXT_DBT_RT_RN through the Data Bank, US$ million, stocks at the end of each quarter plotted at the quarter's first month. This element ends one quarter before the rupee table (report 660); the end-March 2026 dollar figure is in external-debt-annual.
